subject: Launch MAP & Handoff: Aventra Labs - Activation Runbook
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@aventralabs.com>, Marcus Bennett <marcus@aventralabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch MAP & Handoff: Aventra Labs - Activation Runbook

Hi Olivia / Marcus —

Congrats again on executing the agreement — really excited to get Aventra live on Redwood. Per our close conversation, Im looping in the Customer Success and Solutions teams to kick off the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and finalize the evaluation/runbook timeline. Attached is the draft MAP I promised (Aventra_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and the latest SOW for reference.

High-level proposed MAP / ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): Handoff & kickoff meeting — Introductions, goals, success metrics, high-level timeline (owner: Camila / Monica).
- Week 1
: Environment onboarding & credentialing (owner: Lauren).
- Weeks 2-3: Eval runs + perf baselines (owner: Monica; Redwood will run a 3-day perf window and share token/latency breakdowns).
- Week 4: Optimization recommendations and freeze for production (owner: Monica + Lauren).
- Week 5: Go-live prep and final sign-off (Aventra + Redwood).

Key roles on the Redwood side:
- Sales (post-sign): Camila Reyes (owner of the account transition).
- Customer Success: Monica Patel (MAP lead, post-launch health).
- Solutions/Integration: Lauren Bishop (technical onboarding and integration).
- Escalation / Exec sponsor: Marissa Cole (in case of SLA/priority decisions).

Open asks for Aventra ahead of kickoff:
1) Primary technical contact for API keys & network allow-listing.
2) Any NDA/additional security docs we should pre-share.
3) Confirm business success metric(s) you want measured during the eval (e.g., 95th pct latency < X ms / accuracy thresholds).

Proposed kickoff window: Thu Jul 13, 10:30-11:30 PT or Fri Jul 14, 09:00-10:00 PT. Ill send a calendar invite once Olivia confirms.

Thanks — looking forward to the first session.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aventra_MAP_v1.2.xlsx; Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Olivia Zhang <olivia@aventralabs.com>, Marcus Bennett <marcus@aventralabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch MAP & Handoff: Aventra Labs - Activation Runbook

Thanks Camila — Im excited to run this one. Quick notes from the CS side:

- Ive reviewed the MAP and made three small edits to timing (see attached activation-playbook.md).
- Lauren, can you confirm the expected setup time for the integration test harness? If we can get the allow-list IPs and an API key within 48h, we should be able to complete the Week 1 tasks on schedule.
- Rishi, heads-up: Aventra is planning a midsize pilot (projected 50k tokens/day). We may want to propose a dedicated concurrency profile during the eval window.

Proposed owner-level checklist for the kickoff (Ill lead the meeting):
1) Introductions & success metrics (10m)
2) Credentialing & networking (15m)
3) Eval cadence & data inputs (15m)
4) Reporting & acceptance criteria (10m)
5) Next steps & immediate action items (10m)

Olivia / Marcus — can you confirm who from Aventra will be on the call for networking and who will own acceptance criteria sign-off?

Forwarding Camilas availability into the thread; either slot works for me.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (212) 555-0123

Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch MAP & Handoff: Aventra Labs - Activation Runbook

Camila / Monica — thanks for the clear plan and congrats team on getting us signed. I can confirm the following:

- Primary technical contact: Marcus Bennett (ccd). He will own API key requests and coordinate with our network team on allow-listing.
- Acceptance owner: I will be the business owner for the pilot and will sign the eval acceptance when criteria are met.
- Available for kickoff: Thu Jul 13, 10:30-11:30 PT works best.

Ive attached a short one-pager with our pilot scope and data-sharing constraints; we have a security reviewer available on the call if needed.

Look forward to meeting everyone.

Best,
Olivia Zhang
Director, Product Operations
Aventra Labs
olivia@aventralabs.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Perfect — Thu Jul 13, 10:30 PT is locked. Ive created a calendar invite and attached the finalized MAP and activation playbook to the event.

Immediate action items (post-kickoff):
- Marcus (Aventra): request API key and share allow-list IPs (ETA: 48h).
- Monica (Redwood): spin up test harness and schedule perf window (ETA: 72h).
- Lauren (Redwood): review integration checklist and confirm any infra prerequisites (ETA: 48h).

If anything changes, flag here — otherwise see you all on the call.

Thanks,
Camila
